text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories. These programs learn from huge amounts of data and then produce something new. However, many people believe there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. Humans create from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination, while AI simply recognises patterns and combines them. This means AI can be a helpful tool for artists, but it cannot truly feel or understand what it makes. In the end, the best results may come when humans and AI work together.
